summary: Toro Corp., a Cyprus-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an October 8, 2026 agreement with Castor Maritime to amend cross-held convertible preferred stock terms. Castor's 5.00% Series D preferred held by a Toro subsidiary and Toro's 1.00% Series A preferred held by a Castor subsidiary each get their earliest conversion date pushed out one year — to January 1, 2028 and March 7, 2028 respectively. Both boards approved on special-committee recommendation; the companies share a Chairman/CEO. No price, stake, or premium terms disclosed; watch for future conversion-overhang disclosures.
